description: Webhook alerts for up to 5 tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana for 7 days: we re-check each about hourly and POST a signed JSON alert to your https webhook when its risk score or reasons, owner or authorities, or liquidity (10%+) change, optionally price. Returns an id and an HMAC secret; GET /watch/<id> is free. Renew with {id}. Rules-based, not advice. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.

events.description: Comma-separated: risk, authority, liquidity, price; default risk,authority,liquidity

id.description: Renew this subscription for 7 more days instead of creating one

tokens.description: Up to 5 chain:address pairs, comma-separated (chains: base, eth, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, solana); omit when renewing

webhook.description: Public https URL that receives the alerts (POST, JSON); omit when renewing

name: token_watch_subscribe
